metadata.title: Disco Era Ethereal Crown Album Cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A 1970s-style album cover featuring a large, glowing, ethereal crown made of soft-focus light orbs and starbursts. The crown acts as a frame for a central group portrait of men in period suits, set against a deep burgundy and black background with a hazy, airbrushed texture.
coreVisualRelationships: The glowing crown serves as a primary frame for the secondary photographic subject.
High-contrast white typography sits atop a dark, atmospheric background.
Soft-focus light effects contrast with the sharp, structured lines of the group portrait.
coreInvariants: Deep burgundy to black color gradient
Heavy use of swash-heavy, high-contrast serif typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large crown occupies 80% of the frame; a small rectangular group portrait is nested in the lower right interior of the crown.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical axis of the glowing crown.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left typography, follow the curve of the crown down to the group portrait, and then to the title on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark vignetting in the corners creates a sense of depth and focus on the central glow.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep burgundy and black (background and atmosphere)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lavender, pink, and pale blue (glowing orbs within the crown)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-value background with high-value, low-saturation highlights creating a luminous effect.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital gradients; stick to airbrushed analog transitions.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick vertical strokes and hairline horizontals
Elongated, curling swashes on capital letters
Tight letter spacing with occasional overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature ball terminals and extended tails that underline subsequent letters.

typesetting.alignment: Left and Right justified to edges

composition.position: Top left and top right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for both artist name and album title to maintain 70s stylistic consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the iconic 70s decorative curves and weight.
Provides the high contrast and elegant serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark burgundy and black airbrushed background. In the center, create a large crown shape composed of glowing, soft-focus white and lavender light orbs and starbursts. Leave a rectangular space in the lower right of the crown for a group photo of men in 70s suits.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add high-contrast white text in the top corners using a heavy swash-serif font like Bookman Swash. The text should be tightly tracked and have a slight outer glow.

verificationChecks: Is the crown made of light orbs rather than solid lines?
Does the typography feature extreme contrast and decorative swashes?
Is the background a deep, hazy burgundy?
Is the overall mood ethereal and retro-disco?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the burgundy background
mustRedesign: Specific faces in the group portrait
Exact catalog numbers in the corner
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the crown framing does not obscure the text.
Check that the light orbs have a soft, hazy edge.
Verify the typography feels integrated into the 70s aesthetic.
Confirm the color palette remains in the warm/dark spectrum.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark, airbrushed atmospheric background with a central light-based icon (crown) and frame it with high-contrast, swash-heavy serif display type.
